questions.text:
A real number \(t\) satisfies
   \[
   \sin t+\cos t=\frac13.
   \]
   Knowing \(t\) is in Quadrant II, find the exact value of \(\tan t\).

Without a calculator, determine the exact value of
   \[
   \sec\frac{7\pi}{12}-\csc\frac{7\pi}{12}.
   \]

If
   \[
   \cos t=-\frac{5}{13}
   \quad\text{and}\quad
   \sin 2t<0,
   \]
   find the exact value of
   \[
   \tan t+\cot t.
   \]

Let
   \[
   y(t)=3\cos(\pi t)+4\sin(\pi t).
   \]
   Find the largest possible value of \(y(t)\), and one value of \(t\in[0,2)\) at which it occurs.

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.2 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q1
questions.text: Suppose $t$ is a real number such that $\sec t + \tan t = 2024$. Evaluate the exact value of $\sec(-t) + \tan(-t)$.

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.2 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q2
questions.text: Let $f(x) = \frac{x^3 \sec x}{1 + \cos^2 x} - 5\csc(x)\sin^2(x) + 10$. Evaluate the exact sum of $f\left(-\frac{\pi}{5}\right) + f\left(\frac{\pi}{5}\right)$.

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.2 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q3
questions.text:
Evaluate the exact value of the following nested composition: 
$$\tan\left( \frac{\pi}{4} \sec\left( \frac{\pi}{3} \cos\left( \pi \sin\left(\frac{7\pi}{6}\right) \right) \right) \right)$$

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.2 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q4
questions.text: The real number $t$ satisfies the inequality $\tan t + \cot t < 0$. If it is also known that $\sec t > \csc t$, determine the quadrant in which the terminal point of $t$ lies.

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.2 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q5
questions.text:
For the real number $t = \frac{2024\pi}{13}$, determine the exact value of the expression:
$$\sec^4 t - \tan^4 t - 2\tan^2 t$$

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.2 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q6
questions.text: A real number $t$ satisfies $\sin t + \cos t = \frac{1}{3}$. Determine the exact value of $\tan t + \cot t$.
